title: Capital Gains Tax: introduction of a founder relief
text:
The consultation closes on 30 November 2026 and seeks views on the practical application of the new relief.

 Qualifying disposals of shares made from 6 April 2027 will qualify for a reduced rate of Capital Gains Tax of 10% up to a lifetime limit of £10 million.
